name: Gmail MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive Gmail management including sending, reading, and organizing emails, managing labels, drafts, threads, and configuring account settings through the Gmail API with secure OAuth2 authentication.

rawRecord.description: Enables comprehensive Gmail management including sending, reading, and organizing emails, managing labels, drafts, threads, and configuring account settings through the Gmail API with secure OAuth2 authentication.

PORT.description: Port for Streamable HTTP transport method

CLIENT_ID.description: Google API client ID (found in GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH). Required for remote server connection

CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google API client secret (found in GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH). Required for remote server connection

REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth refresh token (found in GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH). Required for remote server connection

AUTH_SERVER_PORT.description: Port for the temporary OAuth authentication server

GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH.description: Path to the Google API Client file

GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Path to the user credentials file
